## Glyphling 0.9.2 (test build for 1.0)

Download `Glyphling-Setup-0.9.2.exe` below and run it. It updates an existing installation in place, keeping settings, themes and position.

### New
- **Calendar events**: right-click a day in the calendar to add an event, a reminder or a task (title, time or all day, repeat, color), like in Google Calendar. They are stored locally on this PC and show up in the widget next to the events of your Google Calendar iCal feed; writing to Google Calendar itself needs a sign-in and is planned for later.
- **Focus timer**: the Pomodoro timer is now called Focus and its duration can be set.

### Fixes
- **Settings title bar**: the window no longer has a non-client area at all (the window procedure ignores it and never repaints it on focus changes), so the native Windows bar cannot come back when the window loses focus.
- **CPU temperature sensor**: Settings now tells apart "not installed", "installed but not running" (with a Start button) and "running"; the sensor is restarted automatically if it is installed but not answering, and the reading tolerates other number formats and sensor names.
- **Cover colors**: the switch now works as expected. On: theme colors. Off: the cover keeps its own original colors.
- **Volume**: the circle's volume looks for the playing app's audio sessions more thoroughly and falls back to the sessions that are playing, never touching the system volume.

The setup is not signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch ("More info" → "Run anyway").
